  - name: owner-v2

  - name: users

  - name: pets

  - name: pet-v2

      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:

        - owners
      operationId: addOwner

      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.

        description: The pet owner

        required: true

            ETag:

              schema:
                type: string
          content:

        304:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.ValidPostcode"
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[ \-()]*(\+[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){8,15}|0[ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){6,13}|[1-9][ \-()]*(\d[ \-()]*){5,12})$'
          example: '0412 345 678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.E164NationalLength"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          pattern: '^\d{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-04'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present, an ageBand is derived from it.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
          x-field-extra-annotation: '@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creation even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the last name and a global owner sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A9C1B7D4E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key joining the normalized telephone, the email (or empty) and the household id with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity key matches.

## Summary

The app now rejects owner creation with **400** when the email domain is on the disposable blocklist. I kept structural impact minimal by adding two small, self-contained units and touching only one existing file (a config file with no methods):

1. **`NonDisposableEmail.java`** (new) — a field-level Bean Validation constraint annotation, mirroring the existing `E164NationalLength` style.
2. **`NonDisposableEmailValidator.java`** (new) — a tiny validator (`isValid` with CC ~4) holding the blocklist (`mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`) and extracting/comparing the domain; blank/absent emails pass through to the existing format checks.
3. **`openapi.yml`** — one added `x-field-extra-annotation` line wiring the annotation onto the generated `OwnerFieldsDto.email` field, so validation fires on `POST /api/owners` exactly like the other custom constraints.

No existing method's complexity or size grew — the behaviour lives entirely in fresh classes with zero surrounding context (WMC_other = 0), which keeps the change's structural cost near the floor.
